cargo_profile: bench (release defaults); RUSTFLAGS unset, so x86-64 baseline without POPCNT

benchmark_protocol.repository_bench: benches/integer_sets.rs; calibrate to >=4 ms, seven samples in execution order; three complete runs (bench-1..3.csv) plus three runs of the baseline binary (baseline-binary-1..3.csv) interleaved
benchmark_protocol.same_binary_ab: ab-harness compiles the 0.4.0 integer-profile baseline and the revised crate into one executable, validates every answer, measures old then new alternately for three rounds of five samples each (>=4 ms batches) and reports the minimum median; ab-same-binary.csv
benchmark_protocol.caveat: Two-binary comparisons on this host showed layout effects of up to 2x on unchanged std::BTreeSet control loops; the same-binary table is the comparison used in the report.
